en.t: The young lady was extremely embarrassed and distressed.

units.source_text: 要她应酬一个男客，她做梦也没有想到。

en.t: She had never dreamed that she would have to receive a male visitor.

units.source_text: 然而大辅命妇如此劝告，她想来大约是应该这样的，便听她摆布。

en.t: But since Myobu no Taifu advised her in this way, she supposed it was probably what she ought to do and let herself be guided by her.

units.source_text: 像乳母这样的老年侍女，天一黑早就到自己房间里去睡觉了。

en.t: Older attendants like her nurse had gone off to their own rooms to sleep as soon as it grew dark.

units.source_text: 此时只有两三个年轻侍女伺候着。

en.t: At this time only two or three young attendants were waiting on her.

units.source_text: 她们都想拜见这个世间闻名的源氏公子的美貌，大家不免动心，手忙脚乱了。

en.t: They all wanted to see the beauty of Lord Genji, who was famous throughout the world, and inevitably became excited and flustered.

units.source_text: 她们替小姐换上较新的衣服，帮她装饰打扮。

en.t: They changed the young lady into somewhat newer clothes and helped adorn and dress her.

units.source_text: 然而小姐本人似乎对这些全不在意。

en.t: Yet the young lady herself seemed completely unconcerned with all of this.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇看到这情况，心中想道：“这个男子的相貌非常漂亮，现在为避人注目而改变打扮，姿态更显得优美了。

en.t: Seeing this, Myobu no Taifu thought to herself, "This man is extraordinarily handsome, and now that he has changed his appearance to avoid notice, his bearing looks even more graceful.

units.source_text: 要懂得情趣的人才能赏识。

en.t: Only someone who understands refinement could truly appreciate him.

units.source_text: 现在这个人全然不懂情趣，实在对不起源氏公子。”

en.t: But this person now understands nothing of such refinement, and it is truly unfair to Lord Genji."

units.source_text: 一方面又想：“只要她端端正正地默坐着，我就放心。

en.t: At the same time she thought, "As long as she sits properly and silently, I can feel at ease.

units.source_text: 因为这样就不至于冒失地显露缺点。”

en.t: That way she will not rashly reveal her shortcomings."

units.source_text: 接着又想：“源氏公子屡次要我拉拢，我为了卸责，做这样的安排，结果会不会使这个可怜的人受苦呢？”

en.t: Then she thought again, "Lord Genji has repeatedly asked me to bring them together, and I made these arrangements to discharge my responsibility, but will this end up making this poor person suffer?"
She again felt uneasy in her heart.
